image_description: Two black hockey pucks resting on a light-colored wooden surface. The puck on the left features a circular white sticker with blue and yellow graphics and text. The puck on the right has a faded, partially illegible logo printed directly on its surface in red and blue/white.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both objects clearly exhibit the standard thick-disk geometry of a hockey puck.
The visual texture and opacity are consistent with solid rubber.
The base material is matte black, though obscured by logos/stickers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Acoustic properties cannot be verified visually.

The rubber texture appears slightly soft and plastic-like, lacking the fine grain typical of vulcanized rubber.
